notes: The three-level chain *the brink of the waters of the Jordan* has one article morpheme, on the Jordan, which takes the *the* before its own word; the two construct nouns take supplied *the*s (rule 29).
`נֹשְׂאֵי` is an articleless attributive on an explicit noun, so the supplied relative stays with the attributive (rule 41), not with a substantival article.
